messages:
maria: Quick sync — planning launch posts + webinar tied to the free-credits experiment. Goal: 10% lift in 7-day activation. TL;DR: test two credit amounts (200 vs 500), two prompt bundles (Starter vs Pro), and count webinar RSVP as an activation signal. Thoughts?

alex: Love it. Keep creative lean — 1 hero post + 2 follow-ups. Webinar should be single-track, pragmatic demo + Q&A. :rocket:

jordan: For routing, we should send inbound registrants directly to a short onboarding flow that surfaces the prompt templates and credit balance. That way we can measure time-to-first-call-to-API.

sam: Can we gate the 500 credits to people who attend live? i.e., RSVP -> reminder -> attend -> claim flow. Lower fraud, higher intent.

maria: Yes — plan: 200 credits on signup, additional 300 locked as "attendance reward". That maps to the two arms.

leah: Copy notes: hero post headline = "Build with LLMs in minutes — free credits + prompt packs." CTA variants: "Claim credits" vs "Register for webinar". We should A/B the CTA wording on social and email.

alex: Metrics to track: signups, webinar RSVPs, attendance rate, 7-day API calls, time-to-first-call, churn at day 7. Also creative-level UTM.

jordan: Routing rules (sketch): if utm_campaign=launch && source=inbound -> send to /quickstart?credits=200&pack=starter unless user registers for webinar, then set locked_credits=300. Use feature flag to flip packs.

maria: snippet for campaign config (for eng/devex):
```
campaign:
  credit_arms: [200, 500]
  locked_attendance_bonus: 300
  prompt_packs: [starter, pro]
  cohort_split: random 50/50
  utm_source: launch_webinar_2026
```

sam: QA checklist: confirm credit ledger entries, ensure locked credits unlocked on attendance webhook, confirm email sequence (reminder -1h, +15m after start).

leah: Webinar content outline: 10m quickstart, 15m demo (using starter prompts), 20m pro use-cases, 15m Q&A. Need two short demo prompts per pack to surface value.

maria: Timing: draft launch posts by Fri EOD, webinar scheduled Tue 2pm PT, registration page live Mon morning. Can growth ops set calendar + CTAs? @ops-bot can you create calendar and registration link?

ops-bot: calendar invite created: "Launch — Quickstart Webinar" Tue 14:00 PT. Registration URL: https://events.redwood.ai/launch?utm=launch_webinar_2026. Reminder emails scheduled.

jordan: For tracking, add event hooks: register, attend, claim_credits, first_api_call. We'll tag user profiles with cohort and pack.

alex: One more ask — include a short benchmark narrative for the announcement: baseline latency and cost numbers for quickstart vs pro prompts so we can show developers expected TCO. Keep it simple in the post.

maria: Agreed. I'll draft the announcement copy + a benchmark blurb (latency e.g., 120ms p50 on hosted, sample token cost).

leah: I'll prepare two hero images (one product screenshot, one customer use-case), and short social captions for LinkedIn/Twitter.

sam: I'll own the post-launch metric dashboard. Set shared look with conversion funnel + cohort breakdown.

maria: Perfect. Owners: copy/leah, ops/ops-bot, devex/jordan, analytics/sam, growth/alex. Next sync Thurs morning if blockers. :thumbsup:

alex: Sounds good. Leaving notes in Notion page -> https://redwood.notion.so/Launch-Credit-Experiment-172111

jordan: Quick question — do we want a follow-up drip for registrants who didn't attend (offering a smaller credit)?

maria: Yes — follow-up: 100 credits + link to recording. We'll iterate after we see attendance rate.

leah: Added checklist to the event page. Will ping when hero images are ready. :camera_with_flash:

sam: thanks all — I'll start building the dashboard and drop a template in #marketing-dashboards.

maria: Thanks team — moving to action."
